title: Bell 407 - Public Safety & Utility Helicopter Elevating Technology
goal: To highlight the capabilities of the Bell 407 in various mission roles.
abstract: The Bell 407 is described as a versatile, multi-role helicopter suitable for public safety, utility, HEMS (Helicopter Emergency Medical Services), corporate, and armed multi-role missions. It features advanced technology, such as an integrated glass cockpit and Precise Flight Pulselite®.

title: Bell 407 - Wikipedia
goal: To provide information on Bell 407 helicopter development and production history.
abstract: The Bell 407 is a four-blade, single-engine utility helicopter developed as a replacement for the Bell 206 series. It has been in service since 1996 with over 1600 produced by early 2023. The aircraft offers enhanced performance and space compared to its predecessors.
capability: Four-blade, single-engine helicopter with advanced rotor design and composite construction for improved performance and passenger comfort.

rest_information: The Bell 407 has been in development since the early 1990s, with its first flight in 1995. It entered commercial service in 1996 and has since been used by various civil and military organizations for utility and surveillance missions.
